title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
text: Raft is a consensus algorithm for managing a replicated log. Leader election, log replication, and safety can be considered separately.

title: SQLite FTS5 Extension
text: SQLite FTS5 is a virtual table module that provides full-text search functionality and BM25 ranking.

title: Faiss documentation
text: Faiss is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.

title: Yjs document updates
text: Document updates are binary encoded and commutative, associative, and idempotent. Peers can exchange missing edits using state vectors.
